{{Quote|The Empire is a rough place to be a miner. I try to look after my people but corruption runs rampant and most officials are a lot more concerned with the numbers making them look good than they are with making the numbers worth anything. '''Kelvus Naria''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kelvus Naria was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
